claims.text: A machine-learning-based interatomic potential can efficiently predict melting properties of refractory high-entropy alloys.
A machine-learning-based interatomic potential can accurately predict melting properties of refractory high-entropy alloys.
A machine-learning-based interatomic potential can predict the melting temperature of refractory high-entropy alloys.
A machine-learning-based interatomic potential can predict the entropy of fusion of refractory high-entropy alloys.
A machine-learning-based interatomic potential can predict the enthalpy of fusion of refractory high-entropy alloys.
A machine-learning-based interatomic potential can predict the volume change at the melting point of refractory high-entropy alloys.
Refractory high-entropy alloys can exist as solid crystalline alloys.
High temperatures are relevant conditions for refractory high-entropy alloys.
The proposed calculation concerns the solid-liquid phase transition of refractory high-entropy alloys.
An interatomic potential mediates the connection between applying the machine-learning method and predicting melting properties.
Machine-learning algorithms and large datasets can be used to develop accurate interatomic potentials for refractory high-entropy alloys.
Machine-learning algorithms and large datasets can be used to develop computationally efficient interatomic potentials for refractory high-entropy alloys.
The machine-learning-based potential improves melting-property prediction relative to traditional DFT-based methods.
Traditional DFT-based melting calculations have high computational cost.
Traditional DFT-based melting calculations have limited feasibility for high-throughput calculations.
Failure to achieve an acceptable prediction error would falsify the hypothesis.
